name: user_email
description: The email address of the user who ran the job.

name: creation_time
description: The time when the job was created.

name: start_time
description: The time when the job started running.

name: end_time
description: The time when the job finished running.

name: query
description: The SQL query text (for query jobs).

name: total_bytes_processed
description: The total number of bytes processed by the job.

name: total_bytes_billed
description: The total number of bytes billed for the job.

name: job_type
description: The type of job (e.g., QUERY, LOAD, EXTRACT).

name: statement_type
description: The type of SQL statement (e.g., SELECT, INSERT, CREATE_TABLE).
